sources.title: gorse-io/larger_clap_music_and_speech-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GGUF conversions of LAION larger_clap_music_and_speech, generated and tested with gorse-io/clap.cpp. This checkpoint is trained on music and speech. Its audio and text encoders output 512-dimensional, L2-normalized embeddings in a shared space. Use the dot product for cosine similarity, audio/text retrieval or zero-shot classification.
